title: run session-load --paid refuses the worker arm, so the paid record cannot hold the lean worker arm's rows
goal: run session-load --paid --arms A,C,D,worker --dry-run plans the worker arm's runs (arm_env already gives the worker environment) and exits 0, so ST-rodj5ltd's paid record can hold the worker arm

run:
import subprocess, sys
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--paid', '--arms', 'A,C,D,worker', '--sessions', '1', '--reps', '1', '--dry-run'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
out = p.stdout + p.stderr
assert p.returncode == 0, ('--paid --dry-run with the worker arm exits', p.returncode, out[-300:])
assert 'arms A, C, D only' not in out, ('the worker arm is still refused', out[-300:])
assert '8 runs' in out, ('the plan does not count 8 runs for four arms, two phases, one session, one rep', out[-300:])

clauses.clause: run session-load --paid --arms A,C,D,worker --dry-run plans the worker arm's runs (arm_env already gives the worker environment) and exits 0, so ST-rodj5ltd's paid record can hold the worker arm
